definitionOfDone: Every foundation, primitive, component, pattern, and template appears once in the entity matrix.
Every entity declares source-of-truth owner, allowed runtime locations, current runtime locations, duplicate surface count, and docs hand-authored surface count.
Style Dictionary is the token build source for foundations/primitives outputs.
Public Flow runtime surfaces use real TypeScript source or are explicitly blocked by the TS migration gate.
FlowDocs consumes generated/package Flow surfaces and must not define component or formal pattern implementations.
Docs-only CSS/JS patterns are blocked by named policy instead of tolerated as invisible debt.

foundation.docsRuntimePolicy: Docs may document and visualize foundations, but must not own foundation behavior, tokens, or raw visual constants.

primitive.docsRuntimePolicy: Docs may consume generated primitive bridges; hand-authored docs primitive implementations require removal or owner decision.

component.docsRuntimePolicy: Docs may compose demos through generated React islands; component behavior, class roots, and contract props stay in Flow.

pattern.docsRuntimePolicy: Docs may own editorial/demo wrappers only; formal pattern behavior, state, slots, and composition stay in Flow.

template.docsRuntimePolicy: Docs may render generated template demos; application-level template composition and QA evidence stay in Flow.

blockedDocsOnlyPatterns.blocked: FlowDocs CSS selectors that define package component class roots such as .button, .field, .drawer, .accordion, or .card.
FlowDocs CSS selectors that define formal pattern roots generated from Flow pattern artifact ids.
Local FlowDocs slot helper modules such as search-slot.js, notification-panel-slot.js, or avatar-menu-slot.js.
Hand-authored DOM factories, raw document interactions, or local runtime copies that bypass Flow React.
Raw hex, px, bezier, shadow, radius, or typography values outside token source/build output policy.

blockers: 7 docs generated candidates do not map to spec
